newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGRICULTURAL BANK SEES 7MLN LITAS 1Q PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK SEES 7MLN LITAS 1Q PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's Agricultural bank said on Friday that it expected its first quarter 1997 net profit to be seven million litas.
"It is planned that the net profit for the first three month of this year will be no less than seven million litas," the spokeswoman for the bank, Imandra Daukshiene, told Reuters.
"The final figures will be announced on April 24," Daukshiene said.
She added that the bank could not provide a comparative firgure for the first quarter of 1996 becuase it had changed its accounting methods.
Its profit for all of 1996 was over 24 million litas.
The Agricultural Bank is the biggest bank in the country in terms of assets.
